algorithm: Bemis-Murcko scaffold groups (RDKit MurckoScaffoldSmiles, includeChirality=False); numpy.random.default_rng(split_seed) permutation of lexicographically sorted scaffold strings; greedy fill with train<=0.8*N, train+valid<=0.9*N; rows sorted ascending inside each split; labels not used for assignment
label_stats_note: descriptive only; labels were not used to generate or adjust the split
